caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate teapot rendered in shades of grey, blue, and muted brown. The teapot has an elongated, curved spout on the left and a large, rounded body. Its surface is detailed with intricate floral and leaf patterns, with the flowers prominently visible in a slightly lighter hue on the body. The handle, on the right, is arched and also decorated with similar floral motifs, including a prominent flower where the handle meets the body. The lid is conical with a decorative finial at the top and has matching patterns along the sides, including symmetrical floral and geometric designs. The composition centers the teapot against a plain, light background, with no additional objects or adornments present.
title: Pewter Teapot
